subject: general
question: Which of the following is a Leadership Development Programme for Minority Women in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **Nai Roshni.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **Central Sector Program** called **Nai Roshni**-a **Leadership Development Program** for **Minority Women** is available to women from **minority communities **who are between the ages of** 18 and 65 **and it **began in 2012–2013.**
 
• By giving knowledge, resources, and tactics to sync with government processes, banks, and other organisations at all levels, the programme aims to empower and** instil confidence in minority women**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Significance of** Nai Roshni scheme** are as follows:

 
• In addition to being important for achieving **equity**,** women's empowerment** is also a key component of our efforts** to eliminate poverty, spur economic growth, and promote civil society.**
 
• In a family living in poverty, women and children always suffer the most and require support and is even more crucial** to empower women**, especially mothers, because it is in the house they raise their children and shape their character.
 
• In addition to claiming their fair share of **government development** benefits for bettering their lives and living conditions,** it empowers minority women to leave the safety and secure environment of their homes and communities and taking their leadership roles and assert their rights to access services, facilities, skills, and opportunities**.
